title: Trinity Blood
label: Quick read (from summaries)
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trinity_Blood (cached copy; article centers on the light novels)
premise: Nine hundred years after an apocalyptic war, humans and the vampiric Methuselah live in a cold war between the Vatican and the New Human Empire. Esther, a nun in the city of Istavan, joins Abel Nightroad, a seemingly bumbling Vatican priest who is secretly a Crusnik, a being that feeds on vampires, as he works with the Vatican's special operations unit AX. Extremists of the Rosenkreuz Order try to keep the two peoples at war while others on both sides seek peace; the manga, adapted from novels whose author died, ends unresolved.
life_message: Peace between enemies is worth sacrificing for, and mercy matters more than which people you belong to.
